name: Config Import
project_description: Config Import (project confi, module machine name config_import) is a small developer helper for importing and exporting a named subset of Drupal configuration programmatically, typically from inside hook_update_N() during a deployment. Rather than running a full site config import (which would overwrite or delete unrelated config), it lets you list exactly the config objects to import or export. It exposes two services: config_import.importer (ConfigImporterService) for selective import/export through core's real ConfigImporter pipeline, and config_import.param_updater (ConfigParamUpdaterService) for patching a single nested parameter inside an existing active config object. It ships no routes, forms, permissions, config schema, or plugins.
